messages:
incident-bot: INCIDENT ALERT: Elevated 5xx rate observed on inference-gateway prod (us-west-2). Auto-pager triggered. Affected paths: /v1/generate and /v1/chat (partial). Initial spike started ~3287654200. Paging sre-oncall.

sre-oncall: I'm on it. seeing ~12% 5xx globally, 40% in us-west-2. Latency also up for errored requests. Any recent deploys? :eyes:

alex (infra): rolled a lb config change 15m ago to add stricter header route matching for X-Client-Version. That change went through canary -> all. Rolling back now if that's likely.

maya (runtime): logs show a lot of 503 from envoy upstream due to route selection failure, and retries amplifying traffic. Example from proxy logs: 

```
[2026-03-10T15:12:03Z] "POST /v1/generate" 503 0 - "-" "envoy" "upstream_reset"
upstream_response_time: -1.000
```

kevin (prod-eng): map looks like header trimming at edge; clients send long Authorization metadata and our LB truncates headers which makes route predicate fail -> falls to default route that has stricter circuit_breaker-> drops -> 503.

alex (infra): confirming: we recently turned on `strip_long_headers: true` in edge proxy config to mitigate client header abuse. That would explain mismatch. We can revert to trim=false or increase header size. Rolling patch to revert now.

ops-bot: deploy started by alex (infra) -> rollback: edge-proxy/strip-long-headers reverted (dc: us-west-2)

sre-oncall: temporary mitigation: disabled retries at gateway layer to stop retry amplification and lowered routing timeouts to fail-fast. Also bumped circuit_breaker thresholds for service inference-router in us-west-2 to avoid immediate ejection. Monitoring.

maya (runtime): reproducer: curl -v -H "X-Client-Version: very-long-version-string-...(repeated)" https://inference-usw2.example.com/v1/generate -> returns 503. After rollback patch, same request -> 200.

kevin (prod-eng): impact summary for incident channel: ~15% of requests returning 5xx at peak, primarily GET/POST to v1 endpoints, customers experiencing timeouts and 503s. No data loss, just failures. Affected customers: small subset of high-header-length integrations.

sre-oncall: current status: rollback rolled out to 3/3 edge pools in us-west-2 (confirmed by deploy bot). 5xx rate dropped to ~1.5% within 4 minutes. Re-enabled retries globally? hold off until we verify steady-state.

alex (infra): patch note: original intent was to mitigate header-based abuse; need a safer rollout path. Creating follow-up ticket to add header-length metrics and canary by client-id.

maya (runtime): action items: 1) write an automated regression test that simulates long headers and verifies route matching, 2) add alert for sudden bump in route defaulting, 3) add a rule in the console to fallback to longer header limit per customer when needed.

kevin (prod-eng): communications: support to send targeted messages to customers who saw errors. I'll draft a short RCA note and a post-incident follow-up.

ops-bot: Note: On-call handoff in 25m to next SRE. Current pager remains with sre-oncall until handoff.

sre-oncall: marking incident as mitigated (5xx back to baseline). Will keep monitoring 30m. Opening postmortem ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-4321. Assigning owners: alex, maya, kevin.

alex (infra): reaction :thumbsup: and will attach the exact config diff to the ticket.

maya (runtime): will schedule a short blameless postmortem review and include reproducible test.

kevin (prod-eng): thanks team. If anyone sees residual spikes, ping oncall and escalate.

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: mitigated -> status: resolved (monitoring). Final impact: brief spike between 3287654200-3287654350, peak 15% 5xx in us-west-2. Root cause: edge LB header trimming + new header-based route predicate inadvertently mismatched traffic -> default route hit circuit breakers -> 503s; retry amplification worsened impact.

sre-oncall: closing thread for now, will attach logs and timeline to ticket. Follow-up meeting scheduled tomorrow 1100 PT.

kevin (prod-eng): filed customer outreach draft in the ticket.

ops-bot: auto-note: incident severity P2, duration ~10m.

alex (infra): adding monitoring dashboard panel for header-length distribution and route-default fallbacks.

maya (runtime): thanks all, good catch. :coffee:
